title: Product Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: A consumable offering of one platform: what a consumer asks for, in the consumer's terms, and what a named team runs. It requires capabilities, optionally narrowed to flows, and runs services. Its features are rows of a register (FE-NNN) with no page of their own.

platform.description: The platform that offers the product.

team.description: The team that answers for the product running.

product_state.description: backlog: offered but not yet available. available: in service. retired: withdrawn.

requires_flows.description: Flows of the required capabilities, as CAP-NNN/flow, when the product needs only some.

runs.description: The services the product runs, by slug or SV-NNN.

features.description: The product's features, where they are listed in the document rather than only in the register.

consumers.description: Who consumes the product, in their own words.
